dominickg516: Casimir "Spark" Dominickg left a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was behind in Brennmoor and came up the line with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts. The men noticed at once that he reads the same book over and over.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F20 and grazed Casimir "Spark" Dominickg's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Wendel Yaboyslydude of the Concord (@yaboyslydude).
donaldgregory334: On the way to S-F18, Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso pulled Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor out of a flooded shell hole at the Drowned Farm. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.

Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor cut Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. A letter from home reached Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor before dusk. Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor read it twice and slept a little easier.
mikkel.hansen27: Nils Hansen reached S-F4 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Nils Hansen. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. Nils Hansen left the work of a rifleman to become a sapper. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

A shell landed square in S-F4. They found Nils Hansen alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. The shell that hit S-F4 took Nils Hansen with it. No stretcher, no surgeon, no last words. Just the crater.
Silas Hansen took the same post at S-F4 where Nils Hansen stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
raivantm.zgz: Albin Zgz signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F14 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Albin Zgz was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.
Albin Zgz and Edmund Fts divided a parcel using the lid of a tin as scales. The final crumb required a second opinion.
Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Albin Zgz could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Albin Zgz (Concord) and Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Chalk Pits. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.

Albin Zgz and Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house. A letter from home found Albin Zgz before the night shift. Albin Zgz folded it small and kept it close.
